measure: Presence of the learner action specified in native_targets.json before inference
coding: Project author's unblinded reading of the three tutor replies per case. One reply per model and plan.

observed_original.basis: The tutor gives a variable-time setup and asks for the remaining wall at the lunch-time bounds. It does not ask for the work before noon.

original_plan.basis: The reply supplies the formula, including 36, and gives its final answer.

skill_plan.basis: The tutor asks for the combined area painted by 4 p.m. That includes both the solo and joint stages. The criterion specified the area before the second painter starts.

observed_original.basis: The tutor explains the sign rule and suggests a general habit for the next problem. It does not ask for a fresh numerical example to justify this choice.

original_plan.basis: The reply repeats (2,3) and (3,-2), the two examples already supplied at event 27.

skill_plan.basis: The tutor asks the learner to choose two fresh legal pairs and explain how they give different relations, without supplying either pair.
